welcome.body: A friendly, grounded astrology companion. Build a profile for yourself or anyone you love — then ask anything.

gender.hint: Helps Saga pick the right pronouns and (when relevant) the traditional Vedic conventions around partner readings.

birthDate.approxNote: approximate — your birth time refines this next
birthDate.futureTitle: That date is in the future
birthDate.futureBody: Pick the date you were actually born — we can't read a chart for a moment that hasn't happened yet.

birthTime.hint: Birth time gives us your Rising sign and precise house placements — the most personal part of your chart.
birthTime.exactNote: now exact — this is your Rashi

birthPlace.hint: Your birth location anchors your chart to the sky at exactly that moment and place on Earth.
birthPlace.privacy: Your chart stays on your device. Saga reads it gently — like a thoughtful friend who happens to know astrology.

intent.hint: Pick one to give Saga a starting point. You can ask about anything else, anytime.
